title: Diagnose (AI)
subtitle: One-tap health check of your car
notConnected: Not connected. Pair your adapter on the Connect tab (or switch to the Simulator in Settings) to run a diagnosis.
intro: Tap “Run diagnosis” to read your car’s fault codes, readiness and live data and get a plain-language health report.

clear.title: Clear fault codes?
clear.body: This erases stored/pending codes and resets readiness monitors. Codes will return if the fault persists.

focus.title: Focused on fault code {{code}}
focus.help: The report explains this code first: what it means, likely causes and what to check.

followUp.title: Ask about this report
followUp.needsProvider: Follow-up questions need an AI provider. This report came from the on-device rules; set up a provider in Settings → AI assistant and re-run the diagnosis.
followUp.placeholder: Ask a question about this report

msg.connectFirst: Connect to a vehicle first (Connect tab).
msg.gathering: Reading fault codes, readiness & live data…
msg.analyzing: Asking the AI model to analyse the data…
